part.text:
Done. Set up module `example.com/netapp` with `golang.org/x/net` for extended networking.

- `go.mod`/`go.sum` — require `golang.org/x/net v0.59.0`
- `main.go` — HTTP/2 server via `x/net/http2` + `h2c` (cleartext) and an echo endpoint via `x/net/websocket`
- `.gitignore` — ignores the built binary

Builds and vets clean (`go build ./...`, `go vet ./...`). Run with `go run .`, then `GET localhost:8080/` or connect a websocket to `/ws`.

Note: the sandbox has no network, so I resolved deps from the local module cache (`GOPROXY=file://$(go env GOMODCACHE)/cache/download`). A normal `go mod tidy` against proxy.golang.org will work once online.
